optional_column.name: source
values: computed from Black Diamond values and flows

emitters.words: Adds source (string, nullable) to ARROW_SCHEMA and to the COLUMNS list together, and writes the account-day's source word on every emitted row, at its own landing. Must NOT change the 19 existing fields, their types, or the 19-column schema_hash that every landed partition is checked against; a table written without source reads as having no source label. The return arithmetic (total_return_daily, return_basis, guard_state) is not touched.

Adds pa.field source (string, nullable) to its ARROW_SCHEMA beside the 19 fields and writes the word orion on every row it builds. Its schema_hash() reads ARROW_SCHEMA by default, so at landing the 19-column check must hash the 19 fields explicitly and a 20-field table is checked against schema_hash_with_optional. Must NOT change the 19 fields, their types or the 19-column hash for tables already landed. Its LABEL constant (OPAL_COMPUTED, defined at line 46 and not used elsewhere in the file) is not the source word and is left as it is.

Adds pa.field source (string, nullable) to its ARROW_SCHEMA beside the 19 fields and writes the word computed from Black Diamond values and flows on every row it builds. Its schema_hash() also reads ARROW_SCHEMA by default, so at landing the 19-column check must hash the 19 fields explicitly. Must NOT change the 19 fields, their types or the 19-column hash for tables already landed, and must keep the source_label schema-metadata key it already carries.

words: Contract 0.3.0 declares source as an OPTIONAL nullable string column under optional_columns, with its own schema_hash_with_optional. The 19 columns, their types and the schema_hash over them are unchanged, so every landed partition and every 19-column check stays valid. The three emitters (the producer and the Inflection and Cottonwood adapters) each must add the column at their own landing; nothing is emitted, landed, pushed or deployed by this record. Until an emitter adopts it, its table carries no source column and a page states no source for it.
